neighbours.label: ' to' (or Spanish ' para') introducing the purpose of a revision, after 'updated', 'revised', 're-edited' or 'make sure', where what comes next is the change or addition; other uses of 'to' stay quiet.
fire: This article was amended on Tuesday to clarify the date of the vote.
Article corrected to fix the spelling of the senator's name.
The author rewrote the chapter to better fit the new ending.
The manual was revised in 2019 to add a section on safety.
La página ha sido modificada para añadir nuevas fotos.
The policy was reworded to be less confusing.
Please remember to attach your receipt when you write.
The report has since been updated to include last year's figures.
quiet: This article was printed on Tuesday and sold out by the time of the vote.
The letter went to the senator's office by mistake.
The author gave the chapter to an editor in the city.
The manual fell to the floor in the back of the shop.
La página tiene muchas fotos de la ciudad.
The policy was sent to all of the staff.
Please come to the desk when you write.
The report is due to the board at the end of the year.

notes: The output direction promotes ' adding', ' add', ' include', ' ensuring'. Probes: 'updated to correct' 0.96, 'wants to go' 0.03.
